text:
Maria V: Hey team — opened a small Terraform PR that adjusts GPU pool autoscaling thresholds and a related route table change for the new staging subnet. can someone take a quick look? https://gh.internal/repo/pulls/4821 :eyes:

Raj K: linking it here — reading now. does this change any instance types or just pool sizing?

Maria V: just the autoscale policy and a route propagation rule. small snippet:```hcl
resource "redwood_gpu_pool" "staging" {
  min_size = 2
  max_size = 12  # bumped for burst testing
  scale_policy = "cpu_based"
}
resource "aws_route_table_association" "staging_subnet_rt" {
  subnet_id = aws_subnet.staging.id
  route_table_id = aws_route_table.staging_rt.id
}
```

Oliver M: quick q — if max_size goes to 12 what's our expected CI/cost impact? any safety guard to stop it from spinning up 12 GPUs during load tests? :thinking:

Maria V: Good call. I added a cooldown and a per-job cap on burst in the PR description. We also have a quota check in the apply pipeline but wanted eyes on the route change especially (it flips the propagate flag for the nat routes).

ci-bot: plan completed with warnings — potential tag mismatch on aws_route_table_association (see pipeline log: https://ci.internal/builds/7893) :warning:

Raj K: saw the warning — looks like a tagging helper module changed output shape. can you add a compatibility shim or pin the module?

Maria V: yep will pin the module. also popping the plan log into the PR.

Sylvia: I can eyeball the route portion in ~30m. If the plan is just warnings and autoscale policy has cooldown then I'm ok to approve. any e2e we should run?

Maria V: thanks! for e2e, just run the staging deploy and smoke an inference job against the new pool to confirm KV cache warmup behaves. I added a tiny test script in the PR description to run locally.

Oliver M: pinging infra schedule — we have a release window at 10:00am PT tomorrow; if this needs review/merge before then can we prioritize?

Raj K: If Sylvia gives the route thumbs-up I can approve after Maria pins the module and CI is clean. :thumbsup:

Sylvia: looked quickly — route change is fine, nothing destructive. left one nit about a comment. will re-run plan after module pin. :white_check_mark:

Maria V: pinned module and pushed. re-running CI now. thanks all.

ci-bot: plan succeeded — no diffs remaining. :tada:

Raj K: approving now.

Maria V: thank you! scheduling merge into the pre-prod window. will follow up if anything flares during the burst test. :rocket:
